description: Defines the KeyboardInputMapper class for handling keyboard input events within the Android input system, including key states, LED states, and configuration.

classes.name: KeyboardInputMapper
classes.description: Handles keyboard input mapping, key states, LED states, and configuration within Android's input system.

methods.name: getSources
methods.description: Returns the input sources associated with this keyboard.

methods.name: reconfigure
methods.description: Reconfigures the input mapper with new settings.

methods.name: getKeyCodeState
methods.description: Returns the state of a specific key code.

methods.name: getScanCodeState
methods.description: Returns the state of a specific scan code.

methods.name: getKeyCodeForKeyLocation
methods.description: Returns key code for a specific key location.

methods.name: updateMetaState
methods.description: Updates meta key state based on key code.

methods.name: getAssociatedDisplayId
methods.description: Gets the display ID associated with the input.

methods.name: updateLedState
methods.description: Updates the state of keyboard LEDs.

methods.name: updateMetaStateIfNeeded
methods.description: Updates meta state if necessary based on key code.

methods.name: findKeyDownIndex
methods.description: Finds index of a key down event by scan code.

methods.name: updateLedStateForModifier
methods.description: Updates LED state for a modifier key.

methods.name: findViewport
methods.description: Finds the display viewport based on configuration.
